Login is optional. This account is provided by api.huanyan.fun and only syncs platform user information, API Keys and available models. Local conversations and other settings stay on this device and are not uploaded by account sync. Signing in and using its model service are subject to the platform terms and privacy policy; model requests are sent to that platform.

梦汐 API accounts are optional and provided by api.huanyan.fun. The app contacts that platform when you register, sign in, sign out, refresh or sync, or when enabled auto sign-in checks or restores your session, sending the username, password, email, verification code, optional invitation code, account access token or refresh cookie required by the selected operation. Credentials are saved encrypted on this device only if you enable Remember credentials. Auto sign-in checks the session when the app starts and signs in again with saved credentials when the session expires; two-factor verification requires manual input. User information, session cookies and API Keys are stored locally; account sessions and remembered credentials are excluded from app backups and Android backup/transfer. Primary and secondary model Keys are exported only when you enable secrets in a backup. Account sync never uploads local conversations, attachments or other settings. When you use this model service, the model request content is sent directly to the platform under its own agreement and privacy policy. Signing out disables auto sign-in, retains remembered credentials for the next manual sign-in, clears the local account session and attempts to revoke that session; model services and Keys remain until you remove them.
